title: Nissin Releases Cold Water Instant Noodles
paragraphs: Usually, you need hot water to make instant noodles. But the Japanese company Nissin has made Cup Noodles that you can make with cold water.
The new product is called Hiyashi Cup Noodle. "Hiyashi" means "chilled" in Japanese. It went on sale at stores across Japan on July 20, 2026. This year is also the 55th anniversary of Cup Noodle.

There are two flavors. The first is Spicy Kimchi, which has a sour and spicy taste. It comes with pork, egg, green onions and sesame seeds. The second is Chicken Salt Lemon, which has a soup made with chicken, fish and lemon. It comes with chicken, egg, green onions and red pepper. Each cup costs 285 yen before tax.
Making the noodles is easy. You just add cold water from the fridge and wait five minutes. Regular Cup Noodles take three minutes with hot water.
Nissin used a special method, called "Cold Rehydrate," to make noodles that become soft in cold water but still have a firm and smooth texture. It took the company five years to develop the product.
The new noodles were very popular. Nissin had planned to have enough noodles for about two months. However, they sold out within one week.
The product may also be useful in emergencies, when people cannot boil water. Nissin has not yet decided if it will make more of the noodles or sell new flavors. For now, they are only sold in Japan.
